name: screen
description: Screen context on macOS: the front app, window, focused control, URL and visible text, kept current by accessibility notifications, redacted in secure fields and blind in the floor's places. On demand screenshots.

tips.text: Type `ask about my screen` in the Capsule to read the window in front and ask about it.
Type `summarize this` and the Capsule adds your screen as a chip, shown before anything is sent.
Select text in any app, then open the Capsule: your words go with the selection attached.
Press `⌘⌫` to take the screen chip off before you send.
Password fields, password managers and sign-in dialogs stay blind: the Capsule sees the app and window title only.
Grant Screen Recording to let Vyre take a screenshot. Each PNG is deleted after 60 seconds.
